Mehbooba Mufti Calls for Disaster Resilience Plan

Mehbooba Mufti, a political leader from Jammu and Kashmir, has urged the government to implement a comprehensive disaster resilience plan. This comes after recent flashfloods in the region, which have affected many people. Mehbooba Mufti's call for a disaster resilience plan highlights the need for the government to prepare for and respond to natural disasters. The plan could help mitigate the impact of future disasters and support those affected by them.
